# app-config.json Schema (M3)
## Root
| Feld | Typ | Pflicht | Beschreibung | |---|---|---|---| | `ui` | Objekt | nein | UI-Basisoptionen | | `actions` | Array | nein | Konfigurierbare Actions fuer Menues, Toolbar und Hotkeys |
## `ui`
| Feld | Typ | Pflicht | Beschreibung | |---|---|---|---| | `theme` | String | nein | `system`, `light`, `dark` (aktuell nur vorbereitet) | | `showHiddenFiles` | Boolean | nein | versteckte Dateien ein/aus (wird in M6 verdrahtet) | | `leftStartPath` | String | nein | Startpfad linke Pane | | `rightStartPath` | String | nein | Startpfad rechte Pane |
## `actions[]`
| Feld | Typ | Pflicht | Beschreibung | |---|---|---|---| | `id` | String | ja | Eindeutige Action-ID | | `label` | String | ja | Sichtbarer Name in UI | | `commandId` | String | ja | Z. B. `file.copy`, `file.move` | | `params` | Objekt | nein | String-Parameter fuer Command | | `shortcut` | String | nein | JavaFX KeyCombination, z. B. `F5`, `CTRL+R` | | `placement` | Array[String] | nein | `toolbar.main`, `menu.file`, `menu.tools` |
## Parameter-Templates
- `${activePane.path}` - `${inactivePane.path}` - `${selection.paths}` (space-separiert) - `${prompt:Frage}` (zeigt Eingabedialog zur Laufzeit)

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<?import javafx.geometry.Insets?> <?import javafx.scene.control.*?> <?import javafx.scene.layout.*?>
<BorderPane xmlns="http://javafx.com/javafx/23" xmlns:fx="http://javafx.com/fxml/1" fx:controller="com.github.uscexp.jfilework.ui.javafx.controller.MainWindowController" style="-fx-font-size: 13px;">
<!-- ═══════════════ TOP: MenuBar + ToolBar ═══════════════ --> <top> <VBox> <MenuBar fx:id="menuBar">
<Menu text="File"> <MenuItem fx:id="copyMenuItem" text="Copy (F5)" onAction="#onCopy"/> <MenuItem fx:id="moveMenuItem" text="Move (F6)" onAction="#onMove"/> <MenuItem fx:id="mkdirMenuItem" text="Create Folder (F7)" onAction="#onMkdir"/> <MenuItem fx:id="deleteMenuItem" text="Delete (F8)" onAction="#onDelete"/> <MenuItem fx:id="renameMenuItem" text="Rename (F2)" onAction="#onRename"/> <SeparatorMenuItem/> <MenuItem text="Exit" onAction="#onExit"/> </Menu>
<Menu text="View"> <MenuItem text="Preferences…" onAction="#onPreferences"/> </Menu>
<!-- Tools menu will be populated dynamically from config in M3 --> <Menu fx:id="toolsMenu" text="Tools"/>
<Menu text="Help"> <MenuItem text="About jFileWork" onAction="#onAbout"/> </Menu>
</MenuBar>
<!-- ToolBar is populated dynamically from config in M3 --> <ToolBar fx:id="toolBar"/> </VBox> </top>
<!-- ═══════════════ CENTER: Dual-Pane SplitPane ═══════════════ --> <center> <SplitPane fx:id="splitPane" dividerPositions="0.5" BorderPane.alignment="CENTER">
<!-- Left Pane — FilePaneController injected in M1 --> <VBox fx:id="leftPane" minWidth="200" style="-fx-border-color: #cccccc; -fx-border-width: 0 1 0 0;"> </VBox>
<!-- Right Pane — FilePaneController injected in M1 --> <VBox fx:id="rightPane" minWidth="200"> </VBox>
</SplitPane> </center>
<!-- ═══════════════ BOTTOM: Status Bar ═══════════════ --> <bottom> <HBox fx:id="statusBar" style="-fx-background-color: #f0f0f0; -fx-border-color: #cccccc; -fx-border-width: 1 0 0 0;" spacing="8" alignment="CENTER_LEFT"> <padding> <Insets top="4" right="8" bottom="4" left="8"/> </padding> <Label fx:id="statusLabel" text="Ready"/> </HBox> </bottom>
</BorderPane>
